faqs: Is the full Odoo ERP system included with the $899 POS Package?
No. The $899 Restaurant POS Package is a standalone front-of-house POS solution. Full Odoo ERP implementation is a separate service starting at $5,000.
What does the $29.99 monthly fee include?
The $29.99 per-user monthly fee covers POS Support & Platform Service only. It does not include ERP implementation, ERP maintenance, or full Odoo ERP usage.
What does the $300 ERP monthly fee include?
The $300 monthly fee covers ERP Management, Maintenance & Support for up to 5 users, according to the agreed ERP implementation scope.
Do I have to buy ERP or Private AI with the POS package?
No. ERP is an optional separate purchase. Private AI and automation have separate scope and custom pricing. The systems can work together through an agreed integration.
No. ERP work follows the agreed implementation scope. Additional customization may be quoted separately.
